summary: Check restaurant availability and manage easyTable bookings (book.easytable.com/book/?id=<placeId>) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the easytable-mcp server — list booking areas/dates/times, look up a booking by phone, and cancel it, all one-shot through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want easyTable access without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
